mechanism: Hypokalemia increases digoxin binding to Na+/K+-ATPase and cardiac toxicity, while hyperkalemia increases digoxin levels and reduces renal clearance, both predisposing to life-threatening arrhythmias.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels closely (maintain 3.5-5.0 mEq/L) and adjust digoxin dosing accordingly; check digoxin levels and ECG when potassium status changes.
